written.summary: The child told about helping grandad wash his red car with a big bucket and a yellow sponge. The grandad sprayed the child with a hose and the child laughed. Biscuit, the dog, jumped in the bucket and got bubbles on his head. The child did the windows with a squeegee and the wheels with a brush. The child said it was so fun and wanted to draw biscuit.
